body:
`README.md:531` tells a user debugging Kobo sync to run:

    docker logs -f calibre-web 2>&1 | grep /kobo/

Two independent defects, and the combination means the command prints nothing even
when sync is working perfectly:

1. Wrong container name. The shipped compose sets `container_name: calibre-web-nextgen`
   (`docker-compose.yml:7`), so the command fails outright with "No such container".

2. Even with the name corrected, the grep cannot match. HTTP access logging is OFF by
   default (`config_access_log`, `cps/config_sql.py:88`, `default=0`) and when enabled
   it writes to `<config>/access.log` (`cps/logger.py:24`), not stdout. No INFO-level
   line in `cps/kobo.py` contains the string `/kobo/` — the sync entry point logs
   "Kobo library sync request received" (`cps/kobo.py:287`), and the only lines
   carrying a URL are `log.debug`.

This is worse than a broken command: it appears in the section whose entire purpose is
distinguishing "the device isn't reaching the server" from "the server isn't sending
the collection", so empty output reads as a diagnosis when it means nothing at all.

Working form:

    docker logs -f calibre-web-nextgen 2>&1 | grep -i "Kobo library sync request"

Found while fact-checking a new docs page against the code; the same corrected form is
used in `docs/kobo-shelves.md`.
title: README's Kobo troubleshooting command shows nothing on a default install
